codebasePath.description: Absolute Git checkout path on the execution device.

fixingProfileId.description: Explicit selectable external Profile ID (used for both Coordinator and Fixing Agents unless coordinatorProfileId is set).

coordinatorProfileId.description: Optional external Profile ID override for the Coordinator; defaults to fixingProfileId when null or omitted.

repository.description: Optional GitHub owner/repo override; derived from codebasePath Git remotes when null or omitted.

worktreeRoot.description: Optional absolute issue worktree parent directory; defaults to <codebasePath>-worktrees when null or omitted.

developmentBaseRef.description: Remote-tracking development base ref; defaults to origin/main.

pullRequestBase.description: Pull-request target branch name (without remote prefix); defaults to main.
